summary: Tested iteration-11 changes end-to-end (no auth app). Backend: new pytest suite for recipe fields (preferment_type, mix_minutes, rest_minutes, bake_temp, bake_minutes, oven_type) + CRUD/persistence/404/422 -> 8/8 passed. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844): header subtitle 'Il laboratorio di Michele' OK; Maestro shows EXACTLY 4 tools (aggiungi/settimana/lavoro/clima), no 'Quando infornare' / 'Gestione forno'; recipe dialog new fields all present with correct IT/DE option labels (Statico/Ventilato con carrello/Rotor; Diretto/Poolish/Lievito madre-Sauerteig/Biga/Altro), standard prices auto-prefilled (1.2 / 0.002 / 1 / 0.5), cost summary + sell price auto-compute, save+reopen persists all new fields; dose-mode toggle grams<->% farina verified (1000g/700g -> 70%, 80% -> 800g); recipe card bake badge '235° · 40′ Statico' present; Piano di lavoro people +/- works and increasing 1->4 people reduced forming 20′->5′ and removed waits, lv-first honored in 'Prepara per primo', per-item bake info shown, voice toggle/test and alarms button present; Clima calc + verdict hot/cold/ok work; Maestro sa tutto has new Corsi tab with new-dot + toast 'Nuovi corsi gratuiti disponibili!', 4 course cards with 2 'Nuovo' badges, dot cleared and localStorage mikilab_courses_v=1 after opening; DE language switch updates tools/dialog/tab labels. Main defect found: both videos in the Video tab are broken YouTube embeds.

minor.issue: Full-replace semantics: RecipeUpdate.model_dump() includes unset fields as None, so any partial update nulls every omitted field (only 'name' is protected). Verified via curl: sending only bake/oven fields wiped flour_type, flour_grams, sourdough_grams, salt_grams, bulk/proofing hours and costing. Use exclude_unset=True (or a PATCH route) for partial saves.

Seeding only runs when the collection is empty and there is no migration/backfill, so the updated MIKILAB_SEED values from this iteration are NOT applied to existing DBs. Live preview data shows all 3 recipes as oven_type=statico / preferment=lm / bake_temp=235 while code expects Ciabatta=ventilato/poolish/22′ and Rustico=230°. Consider upsert-by-name seeding.

ui_bugs.issue: Both YouTube embeds are dead: video-0 (embed/1timJlCT3PM) renders 'This video is private' and video-1 (embed/Z4I3S24u7sA) renders 'Video unavailable' (oembed returns 403 / 404). User sees two unplayable black players.

Course 'source' labels do not match the actual YouTube channels: 'Martesana Milano' -> Eater, 'Masterclass' -> Ricette di Caterina, 'ChainBaker' -> Bread Ritual. Videos play fine but attribution is wrong.

issues: Verdict is derived only from the required water temperature, so an obviously hot room (room=40°C with flour 20 / starter 21) still reports 'Camera OK' (water 14°C). Requirement 'room too hot' is only detected when required water < 4°C.
Result can display physically unusable water temperatures (e.g. 89°C) without clamping to the 4–38°C usable range shown in the code constants.
People count has no visible effect on small batches (default 10 pieces × 4s = 1′ with a 1′ floor); the hint 'più persone = formatura più rapida' can look broken until pieces are large.

action_items: Replace the two broken YouTube embeds in content.js youtubeVideos (IT+DE) with working, embeddable videos.
Fix course 'source' attributions in freeCourses to match the real channels.
Make PUT /api/recipes partial-safe (exclude_unset) or split into PATCH so partial saves don't null other fields.
Add a seed refresh/migration so updated MIKILAB_SEED values (Ciabatta ventilato/poolish/22′, Rustico 230°) reach existing DBs; current preview data shows all recipes as statico/lm/235.
Optional: make Clima verdict consider room temperature directly and clamp displayed water temp to a usable range.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_recipe(): payload.model_dump() without exclude_unset makes every PUT a destructive full replace; only 'name' is guarded.
server.py seed_mikilab_if_empty(): seed changes are silently ineffective for non-empty collections — no versioned seed/upsert.
RecipeDialog.jsx (388 lines) mixes dose-mode math, costing math and markup; the costing block could be extracted into a CostingSection component for maintainability.
StartDoughs.jsx compute(): formMin floor of 1 minute makes the people multiplier a no-op for small batches; consider surfacing per-person totals instead.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_iter11* personal recipes via API (cleaned up). Restored the seeded 'Pane di Altamura DOP' recipe to its code-seed values after UI save testing (water 750, lm, 15′, 235°/40′, statico).

rca_of_the_issue: Video tab: content.js youtubeVideos still points to embed IDs 1timJlCT3PM (now private, oembed 403) and Z4I3S24u7sA (removed, oembed 404); the iframes therefore render YouTube's error page. Stale seeded recipe values: seed_mikilab_if_empty() inserts only when the mikilab collection is empty, so per-recipe oven/preferment/bake values added later in MIKILAB_SEED never reach an already-seeded database.
